title: pm: the queue guard's Tier S record leg checks a same-head record exists but never reads its verdict
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight). Contract review 6886243839 of PR #33531 (card #33501) observed, outside that diff, that `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` passes a Tier S PR when a same-head contract-review record exists and where it came from, and never reads the record's `VERDICT`. Its own self-test pins that a FAIL record still clears. AGENTS.md Prime Directive 14 says the seat lands Tier S on "a PASS verdict", so the gate is weaker than the rule it enforces. PR #33531 is asked to read the verdict for its new low-risk arm; this card covers every other Tier S path (`.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**` and the rest of the register's S rows).

## What lands

1. The record leg parses the record's final `VERDICT:` line and passes only on `PASS`. A FAIL, a missing verdict line or two verdict lines is refused, with the record's comment id in the reason.
2. If several same-head records exist, the latest one decides.
3. Flip the self-test row that clears a FAIL record, and add rows for no verdict and for a FAIL after a PASS.

## Scope

`scripts/pm/**`. Tier S. `skip-changeset`. `Clause-②: no`.
